[LECC.2.3] An adapter must pick the most specific family that
applies. Arguments DS accepted but the adapter cannot use are
`request.invalid_args`, not `internal.bug` — the request was
well-formed at the DS boundary and wrong at the adapter's.
Anything about the upstream the adapter fronts belongs in
`adapter.*` ([LECC.4.3]), not stretched into `request` or
`internal` because one nearly fits.
